description: This file is the main activity for an Android application demonstrating the use of ShareActionProvider with a ViewPager. It manages displaying content items (images and text), updates the share intent based on the current content, and handles user interactions through the ViewPager and options menu.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the UI with a ViewPager, menu options, and share functionality.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager and other components.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu and sets up the ShareActionProvider.

methods.name: setShareIntent
methods.description: Updates the share intent based on the selected content item.
